phase: Phase F2i - basin robustness: step limiting and a Gauss-Newton stationarity test (F2h model)
motivation: every second start (S1 + 100 m, 0.1 m/s) of F2e-F2h ended in a wrong basin (G2 FAIL), and converged good runs ended at the damping limit (G1 FAIL); the S2 first steps were ~95-100 m

change_from_F2h.step_limit: each LM trial step is scaled (direction kept) so that |dr| <= 200 m and |dv| <= 0.2 m/s
change_from_F2h.stationarity: a run that reaches the damping limit is STATIONARY when the undamped Gauss-Newton step at the final point predicts a cost decrease g^T A^-1 g < 0.01 (cost = chi^2 in 1 m / 2 mm/s units, priors included); otherwise DampingLimit
change_from_F2h.runs: S2 = F2h's S1 start + (100 m, 100 m, 100 m, 0.1 m/s, 0.1 m/s, 0.1 m/s), two-day arc directly (no one-day stage), with both changes; S1R = F2h's S1 start with both changes (re-run, so G1 is judged under the new rule and G2 compares like with like)
change_from_F2h.unchanged: F2h's model (N = 300, along-track empirical C_T, S_T; C_N, S_N pinned), data, priors, Doppler bias, A1 FD sensitivities; workers 5 + 5 (two processes, memory-safe)

gates.G1_convergence: S1R and S2 end Converged or STATIONARY (new rule)
gates.G2_start_independence: S1R and S2 agree to <= 1 m in position over the arc
gates.G3_postfit: post-fit range RMS <= 2 m and Doppler RMS <= 5 mm/s for both

reported_not_gated: iterations with the step cap active; RIC vs LOLA and the 2009-262 prediction for S1R
